item.title: a short note about answer engines
item.author: Brenner Cruvinel
item.description:
Every few months answer engines bites me again. This is what finally stuck.

why it matters

Answer engines shows up across seo work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Prefer the obvious solution; clever costs interest forever.
  • Make the default path the correct path so nobody has to remember the rule.
  • The fix that survives is the one the next person can understand.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.

item.title: what i learned about answer engines
item.author: Brenner Cruvinel
item.description:
I keep coming back to answer engines, so here are the notes I wish I had earlier.

why it matters

Answer engines shows up across seo work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Measure before you change anything; intuition is a poor profiler.
  • Start with the smallest thing that works, then make it boring on purpose.
  • Most of the value is in deleting, not adding.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.

item.title: rethinking answer engines
item.author: Brenner Cruvinel
item.description:
A quick write-up on answer engines, mostly so future me stops relearning it.

why it matters

Answer engines shows up across seo work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Start with the smallest thing that works, then make it boring on purpose.
  • If it is hard to test, that is the design telling you something.
  • Name it after what it does, not after how it does it.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.
